command:
set -u
DST=/var/jb/usr/macOS/bin/macos_ws_event_probe
/var/jb/usr/bin/python3 -c "import hashlib;print('uploaded',hashlib.sha256(open('/tmp/evprobe.new','rb').read()).hexdigest())"
install -m755 /tmp/evprobe.new $DST.new && mv $DST.new $DST
ldid -S $DST && ldid -S $DST && echo signed
python3 /var/jb/usr/macOS/bin/macws_boot_trust.py --readd $DST 2>&1 | tail -1
/var/jb/usr/bin/python3 -c "import hashlib;print('postsign',hashlib.sha256(open('$DST','rb').read()).hexdigest())"
ls -la $DST
rm -f /tmp/evprobe.new
